pedagogical_depth.justification: Strict L4 met. (a) Multi-step planning in writing BEFORE building: L5 Phase 1 has child write the rule (AB/ABB/AAB/ABC) on the worksheet before building. (b) Student self-checking by themselves: L5 Phase 5 'find ONE thing on your worksheet to fix' is explicit self-revision. (c) Justification step: L5 Phase 4 child reads parade aloud (animal then number), partner names rule and finds errors — spoken justification + cross-check. (d) Explicit revision opportunity: L5 Phase 5 as separately-numbered action step. 5 distinct response types. Both mid-unit formative + reflection sheet.

instructional_balance.justification: Strict L4 met. CRA: concrete (clap-stomp-jump bodies, animal cards) → representational (parade strips, sticky-rule labels, Core Loops) → abstract (rule labels detached from animals; numbers up to 50). L5 contains explicit 4-stage cycle as separately-numbered action steps: PLAN (Phase 1), TEST on paper (Phases 2-3 build + translate to numbers), TEST WITH MOVEMENT (Phase 4 lead with partner), REFINE on paper + REFLECT (Phase 5).
